title: Develop the exhibition entry guide
objective: Select a structurally qualified one-page guide from distinct editorial candidates.
hypothesis: A choice-led guide will preserve visitor agency more reliably than a route-led guide.
acceptanceCriteria: at least two structurally different candidates exist
rejected direction and rationale are preserved
promotion does not claim human validation
stopConditions: candidate requires an unsupported human-outcome claim
core protocol must be weakened to fit the example
